pages.title: Command Implementation Anatomy
pages.purpose: The uniform pattern every command follows: cli.Command constructors, command.ActionFunc, guard-clause validation with errs helpers, the shared flags package, ui output, hidden commands, and the conventions documented in command/README.md.

pages.title: Runtime and Command Dispatch
pages.purpose: How the binary boots: entrypoint, STEPPATH initialization, command registration via init() side effects, fallback plugin dispatch, global error contract (errs.Error, STEPDEBUG, panic handler, exit codes), version plumbing, and shell completion.

pages.title: STEPPATH, Contexts, and Configuration
pages.purpose: The on-disk state model: $STEPPATH resolution, defaults.json, ca.json, contexts.json and current-context.json, certificates directory conventions, relevant environment variables, and how CA commands resolve ca-url/root configuration.

pages.title: One-Time Tokens and Provisioners
pages.purpose: The JOSE one-time-token model: claims/headers, validity bounds, kid/thumbprint, per-provisioner token generation (JWK, OIDC, X5C, Nebula, SSHPOP, K8sSA, cloud identity), token type sniffing, and audience conventions for each CA endpoint.

pages.title: Authority Setup: ca init and ca bootstrap
pages.purpose: End-to-end flows for standing up a new PKI (init, deployment types, RA options, SSH keys) and for bootstrapping a client to an existing authority (root verification by fingerprint, defaults.json write, trust install, team authorities).

pages.title: OAuth and OIDC Sign-On
pages.purpose: The step oauth command and its reuse by CA OIDC provisioning: loopback PKCE flow with a local callback server, device and out-of-band flows, service-account JWT bearer grants, provider discovery, token output modes, and integration seams.

pages.title: Renewal, Rekey, and Revocation
pages.purpose: How step ca renew/rekey/revoke work: mTLS vs renewal-token authentication, daemon mode with signals and exec/pid hooks, --force and --expires-in semantics, needs-renewal exit codes, and the systemd cert-renewer units.

pages.title: SSH Certificate Lifecycle
pages.purpose: The step ssh command family: certificate issuance, login/logout and agent integration, identity certificates with machine UUID SANs, config template installation, proxycommand/bastion behavior, and SSH renewal/rekey/revoke.

pages.title: X.509 Issuance Flow
pages.purpose: The end-to-end step ca certificate and step ca sign flows: token acquisition, key/CSR creation with per-provisioner SAN defaults, subject validation, API sign call, offline mode against ca.json, and where certificates are written.

pages.title: Guide: Adding a New Command
pages.purpose: Focused change guide: where to put the package, how to register it, wire flags, validate args, produce output, write unit and testscript integration tests, and update the CHANGELOG.

pages.title: Guide: Extending Token Provisioning
pages.purpose: Focused change guide: how a new provisioner token type or new token claim flows through the token package, token_generator, token_flow dispatch, and CA flows, with the invariants that must hold.

pages.title: KMS and Plugin Integration
pages.purpose: How keys in HSMs/KMSs/TPMs are used via KMS URIs that shell out to step-kms-plugin (internal/cryptoutil), and how unknown step subcommands resolve to plugin executables (internal/plugin, exec, fileserver/base64 trivia of the fallback path).

pages.title: Build and Release Pipeline
pages.purpose: From source to released binary: Makefile targets, GoReleaser Pro configuration (14 platform targets, nfpm packages, cosign signing, S3/GCS/winget/scoop publishing), CI workflows, Docker images, doc regeneration, and version injection.

pages.title: Testing Strategy
pages.purpose: How the repo is validated: unit tests, the testscript-based integration suite that runs the real command tree, help-quality linters, how to run tests (make test, -short, race), and conventions new tests should follow.

pages.title: JOSE Crypto Toolkit
pages.purpose: The standalone crypto commands: jwt sign/verify, jwe encrypt/decrypt, jws, jwk create/keyset management (flocking, JWE-wrapped private JWKs), change-pass, kdf, nacl, otp, and the --subtle/--insecure misuse gates.

pages.title: Local X.509 Utilities and Trust Stores
pages.purpose: Certificate utility commands that work without a CA: bundle, inspect (local/remote), fingerprint, lint (zlint), verify with OCSP/CRL checks, format, key, p12, install/uninstall of root CAs into system/Java/Firefox trust stores, and crl inspect.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical onboarding: build, test, lint, run the step binary, repo layout overview, where to make first changes, and pointers into the rest of the wiki.
